item.title: The Cognitive Awakening
item.description: Subtitle: The Driving Force That Initiates Self-Change Author: Zhou Ling Publisher: Posts & Telecom Press Publication Year: 2020-10 ISBN: 9787115543424 Notes: The book is divided into two parts. The first part is inward-looking: understanding yourself. Starting from the triune brain theory, it explains how the brain works. The instinctive brain maintains basic physiological needs, the emotional brain handles emotion and social interaction, and the rational brain processes logic and decision-making.
item.dc:creator: WeChat Official Account

item.title: Understanding the Geopolitical World in One Book
item.description: Author: Wang Wei Publisher: CITIC Press Publication Year: 2017-10-15 ISBN: 9787508667751 Notes: Within ten thousand years, geography is an unchangeable fact and a field that strategists continue to study in depth. To China’s east, past Japan and across the North Pacific, lies the United States; to China’s southwest, through the Indian Ocean and the Atlantic, China is also connected to the United States.
item.dc:creator: WeChat Official Account

item.title: Symmetry and Asymmetry
item.description: Author: [US] T.D. Lee Publisher: Tsinghua University Press Published: 2000-05 ISBN: 9787302038665 Notes: I used to enjoy reading about mathematics and physics. After starting work, I was consumed by solving all kinds of project and technical problems, and gradually lost my curiosity about what the world really is. Thanks to the author’s deep mastery, this book presents symmetry and asymmetry across many fields and scenarios with ease, giving the reader a fairly direct feel for the consistency that lies within this contradiction.
item.dc:creator: WeChat Official Account

item.title: Measure What Matters
item.description: Subtitle: The Working Method Behind the Explosive Growth of Google and Amazon Author: John Doerr (US) Publisher: CITIC Press Publication Year: 2018-12 ISBN: 9787508696881 Notes: OKR stands for Objectives and Key Results, a working method for managing goals and their completion invented by Intel founder Andy Grove. The O stands for Objective, which should be important and specific, action-oriented, and inspiring — for example, improving the stability of a system.
item.dc:creator: WeChat Official Account

item.title: The Low-IQ Society
item.description: Subtitle: How to Break Out of the Decline of IQ Author: (Japan) Kenichi Ohmae Publisher: CITIC Press Publication Year: 2010-4 ISBN: 9787508619262 Notes: What is worth noting is when this book was written. More than a decade later, reading it still conveys its weight. The more developed the network, the lazier the brain.

item.title: The Definitive Guide to Kubernetes Networking: Fundamentals, Principles, and Practice
item.description: Author: Du Jun Publisher: Publishing House of Electronics Industry Published: 2019-10 ISBN: 9787121373398 Notes: Networking is one of the harder parts of Kubernetes to master. Network failures directly affect the running workloads, and they are usually very urgent problems. Networking knowledge is also lower-level than application development, with many details that require long-term accumulation.

item.title: DevOps Essentials: A Business Perspective
item.description: Author: (Russia) Oleg Skrynnik Publisher: Tsinghua University Press Publication year: 2020-05-01 ISBN: 9787302547143 Notes: As the title suggests, the book focuses on DevOps from a business perspective. From its origins to its foundations, from principles to practice, you can take something away at every level. DevOps rests on lean production (the Toyota production line) and agile development, with the value chain at its core.

Publication Year: 2019-2-1 ISBN: 9787569932171 Notes: The author is a very famous management scholar; I have previously read another book of his, The Art of Thinking. item.title: The Era of Cloud Work
item.description: Author: Wang Jianguo / Wu Bin Publication year: 2016-11-1 ISBN: 9787508668024 Notes: The book’s main point is that in the internet era, working from home and collaborating remotely is a better fit. From there it goes on to discuss how business owners and workers can harness this way of working, and the author offers some of his own thoughts.

item.title: Building Microservices
item.description: Author: [UK] Sam Newman Publication year: 2016-5 ISBN: 9787115420268 Notes: It mainly answers a series of questions about microservices. What microservices are, what characteristics they have, how systems evolve, how to divide services, and integration, deployment, and testing strategies. It gives a fairly comprehensive introduction to microservices, and many of its views resonate with me.

item.description: Author: Fan Bing Subtitle: A Secret Playbook for User and Revenue Growth in Startups Publication year: 2015-7 ISBN: 9787121263606 Notes: This is a fairly marketing-oriented book aimed at ToC internet products. Through all kinds of real cases, it shows you the playbook of internet products: how to create a product, acquire users, spark activity, improve retention, increase revenue, and spread virally.

item.title: Love and Math
item.description: Author: Edward Frenkel (USA) Original title: Love and Math: The Heart of Hidden Reality Publication year: 2016-3 ISBN: 9787508658070 Notes: I finished this book on the high-speed train during a round trip. It is a fairly light, autobiographical kind of mathematics book. It mainly follows the timeline of the author’s schooling, and tells the story of how a boy interested in physics, step by step and through unremitting effort, became a world-class mathematician.

item.title: Notes on The Art of Readable Code
item.description: 1. About Names Choose professional words Avoid overly generic names Use concrete names instead of abstract ones Use prefixes or suffixes to attach more information to a name Decide how long a name should be Use the formatting of a name to express meaning 2.
